# Social cohesion

In this section, we harmonize the social cohesion questions of the 2021 annual survey, the 2022 annual survey and the two 2023 rounds. The 2022 PDM and earlier rounds did not ask them.

* **Relations between groups:** whether household members had relations with transhumant herders, farmers, displaced people and the host population, and how the household rates these relations, from 1 (very negative, hostile) to 5 (friendly and equal). The 2023 questionnaire addresses each question to one type of household (for example, resident farm households about transhumant herders), but nearly all households answered all four. Answers are coded 1 = No, 2 = Yes, 3 = Don't know in 2021 and 2022, and 0, 1, 888 in 2023: recoded to 0 = No, 1 = Yes, 888 = Don't know.
* **Tensions:** whether the assets created helped reduce tensions over natural resources. The same question is asked in the asset benefit section (`ABITensions`, already in the merged file), and the two answers agree for about three households in four. Both are kept.
* **Whom the household could help** in the community: relatives, unrelated people of its ethnic group or clan, people of another group, or nobody (multiple choice).

```{r 26 packages needed}
library(haven)
library(labelled)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r 26 remove environment variables}
rm(list = ls())
```

```{r 26 environment settings}
dir_input_data = "C:/Users/AHema/OneDrive - CGIAR/Desktop/WFP Resilience dataset/data/input_data/Chad"
dir_output_data = "C:/Users/AHema/OneDrive - CGIAR/Desktop/WFP Resilience dataset/data/output_data/Chad"
```

```{r 26 read harmonization excel file}
Chad_Harmonization_variables <- read_excel(paste0(dir_input_data, "/Chad_Harmonization_extension.xlsx"), sheet = "variables_harmonization") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Module == "Cohesion")
Chad_Harmonization_description <- read_excel(paste0(dir_input_data, "/Chad_Harmonization.xlsx"), sheet = "description")
Chad_Harmonization_ID <- read_excel(paste0(dir_input_data, "/Chad_Harmonization.xlsx"), sheet = "variables_harmonization") %>%
  dplyr::filter(NewVariable_Name == "ID")
```

```{r 26 data importation}
lst_data = Chad_Harmonization_description$Data
lst_test = Chad_Harmonization_description$Name
for (i in 1:length(lst_data)) {
  assign(lst_test[i], read_sav(paste0(dir_input_data, "/", lst_data[i])))
}
```

```{r 26 select and rename columns needed}
for (j in 1:length(lst_test)) {
  raw <- get(lst_test[j], envir = .GlobalEnv)
  df <- tibble::tibble(.rows = nrow(raw))
  id_var <- Chad_Harmonization_ID[[lst_test[j]]]
  df$ID <- if (is.na(id_var)) NA_character_ else { z <- zap_labels(raw[[id_var]]); if (is.numeric(z)) format(z, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE) else as.character(z) }
  for (i in 1:nrow(Chad_Harmonization_variables)) {
    v <- Chad_Harmonization_variables[[lst_test[j]]][i]
    df[[Chad_Harmonization_variables$NewVariable_Name[i]]] <- if (is.na(v)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(zap_labels(raw[[v]]))
  }
  assign(lst_test[j], df)
}
Chad_pdm_2022$ID = as.character(1:nrow(Chad_pdm_2022))
```

```{r 26 helpers}
vars <- Chad_Harmonization_variables$NewVariable_Name
interact <- grep("^CohInteract", vars, value = TRUE)
relation <- grep("^CohRelation", vars, value = TRUE)
help <- grep("^CohCouldHelp", vars, value = TRUE)
recode <- function(x, no, yes, dk = NA) { stopifnot(all(x[!is.na(x)] %in% c(no, yes, dk))); dplyr::case_when(x == yes ~ 1, x == no ~ 0, x == dk ~ 888) }
```

## EA 2021 and EA 2022: 1 = No, 2 = Yes, 3 = Don't know

```{r}
for (r in c("Chad_ea_2021", "Chad_ea_2022")) {
  d <- get(r)
  for (v in interact) d[[v]] <- recode(d[[v]], 1, 2, 3)
  d$CohTensionsReduced <- recode(d$CohTensionsReduced, 1, 2)
  assign(r, d)
}
```

## PDM 2023 and EA 2023: 0 = No, 1 = Yes, 888 = Don't know

```{r}
for (r in c("Chad_pdm_2023", "Chad_ea_2023")) {
  d <- get(r)
  for (v in interact) d[[v]] <- recode(d[[v]], 0, 1, 888)
  d$CohTensionsReduced <- recode(d$CohTensionsReduced, 0, 1)
  assign(r, d)
}
```

## Merging all data

```{r}
df_Chad <- dplyr::bind_rows(mget(lst_test))
for (v in relation) stopifnot(all(df_Chad[[v]] %in% c(1:5, NA)))
for (v in help) stopifnot(all(df_Chad[[v]] %in% c(0, 1, NA)))
```

```{r}
for (v in interact) df_Chad[[v]] <- labelled(df_Chad[[v]], c("No" = 0, "Yes" = 1, "Don't know" = 888))
for (v in relation) df_Chad[[v]] <- labelled(df_Chad[[v]], c("Very negative, hostile" = 1, "Dissatisfied, unpleasant" = 2, "Neither positive nor negative" = 3,
                                                             "Polite or courteous" = 4, "Friendly and equal" = 5))
for (v in c("CohTensionsReduced", help)) df_Chad[[v]] <- labelled(df_Chad[[v]], c("No" = 0, "Yes" = 1))
for (i in 1:nrow(Chad_Harmonization_variables)) var_label(df_Chad[[Chad_Harmonization_variables$NewVariable_Name[i]]]) <- Chad_Harmonization_variables$Label[i]
var_label(df_Chad$ID) <- "Household ID"
```

## Export all data

```{r}
df_Chad <- df_Chad %>% dplyr::select(ID, all_of(vars))
haven::write_dta(df_Chad, paste0(dir_output_data, "/", "WFP_Chad_Cohesion.dta"))
```
